name: CaptchaFox
description: A privacy-focused CAPTCHA provider for the CAPTCHA module. Verifies the challenge SERVER-SIDE (Drupal POSTs the response + secret to https://api.captchafox.com/siteverify and only passes on success) — the client can't self-assert. Store the secret key securely.
project_description:
The CaptchaFox module integrate CaptchaFox web service to improve the CAPTCHA system.

 Features 
 CaptchaFox helps you protect your form by adding CaptchaFox integration to Captcha module.

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module.

 Requirements 
 
 CAPTCHA module 
 CaptchaFox account 
 
 Configuration 
 
 Enable CaptchaFox and CAPTCHA modules in: admin/modules 
 You'll now find a CaptchaFox tab in the CAPTCHA administration page

 available at: admin/config/people/captcha/captchafox 
 Create an account in the CaptchaFox Website 
 Input the site and secret keys into the CaptchaFox settings 
 Visit the Captcha administration page and set where you want the

 CaptchaFox form to be presented: admin/config/people/captcha 
 Back to top
